speaker: Mr David Hoe
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) aside from demand, potential disamenities, fire safety, exit capacity and structural loading, what other constraints may limit the conversion of unde-rutilised HDB multi-storey car park (MSCP) spaces for community uses; and (b) whether such constraints apply to the MSCP at Clementi Peaks.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Housing and Development Board (HDB) periodically receives requests to repurpose multi-storey car parks (MSCPs) for alternative uses.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This matter was also raised by the Member for Sengkang Group Representation Constituency (GRC), Assoc Prof Jamus Lim, during the Committee of Supply (COS) 2026 debate for the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth last month.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: As MSCPs are built for vehicle parking, HDB would need to carefully evaluate proposals to repurpose these MSCPs.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: They have to bear in mind considerations, such as residents' needs and safety.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The assessment also includes the factors cited by Mr David Hoe, such as having enough lots to meet the demand for parking over time, potential disamenities to residents and technical considerations including fire safety requirements, exit capacity and structural loading.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: It is important for me to clarify this point, so that members of the public have the correct set of facts and do not form the wrong impression based on what Assoc Prof Lim said.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In the case of Clementi Peaks, the project was completed less than four years ago in July 2022.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: What criteria or benchmark are we looking at?

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: And how did we arrive at these criteria and benchmark?

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: And oftentimes, I see that residents are doing their jogs, children are cycling, parents are teaching their children how to cycle.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: I understand that in the current situation, current circumstance, that it is not ready to be repurposed.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: Because when they look at me, they are just asking for space and we do have space at Level 7 of the MSCP, but it is severely under-utilised with no cars at Level 7 on occasional visits.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On Mr Hoe's first question, parking demand can change and evolve over time, especially in a new estate.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: You could have changes in household sizes and with that, changing in parking needs.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: That is why it can take quite a number of years before parking demand in a new estate stabilises.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On Mr Hoe's second question, our HDB estates are designed with playgrounds, with community spaces, with open lawns.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: And residents can use these places for leisure.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: And yet, in my experience, HDB has seemed very reticent to appeals for change of use.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
text: Perhaps the Senior Minister of State could clarify a clear set of criteria for appeals of change of use that HDB takes into consideration, that Town Councils can submit to ensure that such requests will be taken into account seriously.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Could I first ask the basis for the statement that the Member made on 5 March, last month?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Because, and I quote, the Member had mentioned that, "One objection is that there is an opportunity cost to foregone income, since such lots could generate potential revenue and this has sometimes been MND's response to requests for converting car park spaces to other uses, such as community gardens".

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Could I first clarify if there was correspondence with the Ministry of National Development (MND) that suggests that this is why the Member thinks that the MND is not allowing the conversion of the MSCPs?

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: This was conveyed to me by Town Council staff.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: If I was mistaken in this statement, I will retract that request.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: But nevertheless, I think the general spirit of my question remains, which is that in prior requests that the Town Council has made requesting a change of use, MND has cited various reasons for not permitting this change of use.

speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
text: And hence, my request for asking for a clear set of criteria.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The Member might want to check with his Town Council staff, because I have a copy of correspondence between the Member as well as the HDB staff.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: The Town Council staff might have been copied.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: This was in relation to a request that the Member made in 2021.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: Then, it goes on to say that "HDB does look into requests for conversion of car park lots into alternative non-parking uses at suitable sites, if the carparks are assessed to be sufficient to meet parking needs after the conversion of the lots.
